crossRefs.note: Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of Yahweh.
My son, listen to your father’s instruction, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching:
for they will be a garland to grace your head, and chains around your neck.
Listen, sons, to a father’s instruction. Pay attention and know understanding;
My son, pay attention to my wisdom. Turn your ear to my understanding,
My son, keep your father’s commandment, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching.
My son, keep my words. Lay up my commandments within you.
Now therefore, sons, listen to me. Pay attention to the words of my mouth.
“Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.
Listen to your father who gave you life, and don’t despise your mother when she is old.
My son, give me your heart; and let your eyes keep in my ways.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Assemble yourselves, and hear, you sons of Jacob. Listen to Israel, your father.
translations.bsb: Come together and listen, O sons of Jacob; listen to your father Israel.
translations.kjv: Gather yourselves together, and hear, ye sons of Jacob; and hearken unto Israel your father.
translations.asv: Assemble yourselves, and hear, ye sons of Jacob; And hearken unto Israel your father.
